title: Is Value Investing Still Relevant?
text: Does value investing still work? All right, so for 80 years, cheap stocks beat expensive ones. This is going back from 1926 to 2006. 25 times expansion of value over growth. If you're unfamiliar with what value is versus growth, value are the cheapest 30% of stocks, growth are the most expensive 30% of stocks. Then in '07, things really slowed down. So the peak was in Feb of '07 with that 25 times growth of just value smashing it. And the gap that we sit right now against the '07 peak is like down 43% value versus growth.
